newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle market at standstill -USDA.

text.p: Trade was inactive in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers; following weekly movement of 133,500 head.
The last established price was $64.00 per cwt on Thursday.
Friday's packer bids were $64.00, with asking prices $65.00-$66.00. N
ote - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
